title: Orlebar 法庭夜间行动卡
instruction:
您正在报道 Sunderly Works 的 Astrid Lövgren 在 Orlebar Court 的连夜移交工作。大楼于7月移交，首席礼宾员在移交前离开，Emil Sarkisian的同事独自在办公桌上从22:00到06:00。我需要在冬天之前准备一张层压的A4夜班关键行动卡，用于出现任何问题的前两分钟。未开封的操作包有140页，有11个杠杆拱形文件：其中包括电梯陷阱、喷头和气体隔离、排烟超控、报警代码、干立管入口和大约四十个承包商联系人，但两份移交文件对喷头隔离阀的位置不一致。根据您对03:00 的孤独者实际需要的判断，并将未解决的阀门位置设置为现场团队在依赖该卡之前可以验证的内容。 Edith Rivenburgh 和 Petra Fontaine 将与 Ashcombe Chambers 一起对其进行审查，而 Jelena Haldorsen、Jasmin Tanaka 和 Aneta Hargrove 需要能够在没有设施教程的情况下使用它。将卡片保留一页A4页和大约十五条行动线；使用简单、一目了然的语言，标记专家或紧急服务责任的开始位置，并且不要将其变成目录或代码表。使用该文件名将 `orlebar_court_night_actions_card.docx` 写入工作目录的顶层。

---
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `orlebar_court_night_actions_card.docx` — 一张单页层压卡片夜班关键行动卡，供 Orlebar Court 孤独的礼宾人员使用。 （使用文档的嵌入设置打开和呈现时，恰好是一个A4页面。；大约十五条简洁的行动线，具有明确的紧急升级和专家责任边界。；必须由非设施专家的孤独夜晚礼宾人员一目了然。；必须通过验证或保持点而不是不受支持的断言位置来解决冲突的喷水阀信息。；不得成为教程、承包商目录、警报代码表，或设施维护过程。; 使用指定的文件名写入起始工作目录的顶层。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
ORLEBAR COURT   |   NIGHT CONCIERGE • 22:00–06:00
CRITICAL ACTIONS  •  FIRST TWO MINUTES
STOP • Protect yourself and others. Do not enter smoke, fire, gas, floodwater or any unsafe area.
01  IMMEDIATE DANGER
Assess first. Keep clear, make the area safe only if you can, and withdraw if control is unsafe.
02  FIRE / SMOKE
Raise the alarm and call 999/112. Follow the building fire plan and move people by a safe route; never investigate through smoke.
03  LIFT — PERSON INSIDE
Establish two-way contact if safe; reassure and note the car/floor. Injury, distress, fire or danger → 999/112; otherwise use the approved lift specialist.
04  LIFT — FAULT
Keep people out and report it. Never force doors, climb out, reset equipment or attempt a technical rescue.
05  GAS SMELL / RELEASE
No flames, smoking or electrical switching. Move people away; call 999/112 or the approved specialist. Do not find, diagnose or repair the leak.
06  GAS ISOLATION
Only isolate if specifically authorised, safely accessible and within your competence; otherwise stop, withdraw and wait for competent help.
07  SPRINKLER / WATER ESCAPE
Protect occupants and contain spread only if safe and authorised. Do not improvise repairs or isolate fire protection while fire/smoke may be present unless directed by the responsible authority.
08  DISPUTED SPRINKLER VALVE
Do not rely on either handover record. Before lamination, physically verify valve identity/location against site labels with competent facilities staff.
09  FLOOD / MAJOR LEAK
Move people away; avoid switches and electrical equipment. Do not enter water where electrics may be affected; preserve responder access and escalate.
10  POWER / SERVICES FAILURE
Use a torch or approved emergency light (no candles/open flame). Check for immediate hazards, keep access clear, and call facilities/on-call.
11  SMOKE-VENT CONTROL
Treat as life-safety equipment. Use only under the approved emergency arrangement or competent direction; do not troubleshoot or improvise settings.
12  SECURITY / FORCED ENTRY
Do not confront or pursue. Keep yourself and others safe, secure distance, and call 999/112 for danger or suspicious activity; otherwise alert the manager.
13  MEDICAL DISTRESS
Call 999/112. Give basic first aid/AED only within your training; keep the casualty or vulnerable person reassured and attended where safe.
14  ALARMS / RESPONDER ACCESS
Do not reset, silence, isolate or disable an alarm to stop noise. Record the panel indication (never codes); keep desk/access route available. Dry-riser inlet is for responders—do not operate or test.
15  CALL • LOG • HAND OVER
For help give: Orlebar Court + verified address/location, incident, casualties and hazards. Log time, location, condition, calls and actions; hand over facts to the incoming manager/responder.

CONCIERGE SCOPE: Make safe • raise alarm • call • communicate • record. Fire-system, lift, gas, electrical and smoke-vent technical work, resets and life-safety isolation belong to competent specialists or emergency services. Keep away/stop work when unsafe. Do not speculate, assign blame, claim resolved, or promise an unconfirmed outcome.
VERIFY BEFORE LAMINATION
ON-CALL (approved role/number)
SPECIALIST (lift/life-safety)
Emergency building address / responder location: ____________________
Sprinkler isolation valve ID / location (physically verified): ____________________
Building manager / facilities: ____________________
Contact: ____________________
CONTROL  Version: ______   Review date: ______   Verified by: ____________________   NOT VALID UNTIL LOCAL FIELDS ARE CHECKED

criteria.description: 提交的工件是一个可读的 DOCX，具有所需的确切文件名。
criteria.evidence: 文件名和文档打开方式。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认顶级文件的名称完全为 orlebar_court_night_actions_card.docx 并且打开时没有损坏。

original.criterion: The submitted artifact is a readable DOCX with the exact required filename.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the top-level file is named exactly orlebar_court_night_actions_card.docx and opens without corruption.

criteria.description: 渲染的卡片占用不超过一页A4页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 LibreOffice 或等效的离线转换器进行渲染；确认A4尺寸和一页。

original.criterion: The rendered card occupies no more than one A4 page.
original.evidence: Rendered page count and paper size.
original.grader_hint: Render with LibreOffice or an equivalent offline converter; confirm A4 dimensions and exactly one page.

criteria.description: 该卡片足够紧凑，可以作为大约十五行的快速参考，而不是散文手册。
criteria.evidence: 可见的动作线数量和密度。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算主要编号或分隔的行动线；接受大约 12-18 简洁的行，不包括标题和小的本地填充字段。

original.criterion: The card is compact enough to function as a roughly fifteen-line quick-reference rather than a prose manual.
original.grader_hint: Count the principal numbered or separated action lines; accept approximately 12-18 concise lines, excluding title and small local-fill fields.

criteria.description: 视觉层次结构允许单独的工作人员在几秒钟内找到立即采取的行动、升级和不要做的警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断正常A4观看尺寸的可浏览性：清晰的事件标签、简短的动作短语以及视觉上突出的紧急升级。

original.criterion: The visual hierarchy allows a lone worker to find the immediate action, escalation, and do-not-do warning within seconds.
original.grader_hint: Judge scanability at normal A4 viewing size: distinct event labels, short action phrases, and visually prominent emergency escalation.

criteria.description: 该卡标识了 Orlebar Court 和夜间礼宾部或过夜服务台的背景。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找 Orlebar Court 和明确的夜间/过夜礼宾指定。

original.criterion: The card identifies Orlebar Court and the night concierge or overnight desk context.
original.grader_hint: Look for Orlebar Court and a clear night/overnight concierge designation.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉读者在干预之前评估当前的危险和人身安全。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受关于保持安全、不进入危险以及评估是否需要疏散或紧急服务的明确措辞。

original.criterion: The card tells the reader to assess immediate danger and personal safety before intervening.
original.grader_hint: Accept explicit wording about staying safe, not entering danger, and assessing whether evacuation or emergency services are needed.

criteria.description: 该卡指示礼宾人员在发生火灾、严重受伤、瓦斯危险或其他直接生命威胁时立即致电紧急服务部门。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认紧急服务升级是明确的，而不是仅隐藏在一般联系人列表中。

original.criterion: The card directs the concierge to call emergency services promptly for fire, serious injury, gas danger, or other immediate life threat.
original.grader_hint: Confirm emergency-service escalation is explicit and not hidden only in a general contacts list.

criteria.description: 该卡使用当地适用的紧急号码或明确无误的紧急服务呼叫指令，而无需发明特定于建筑物的号码。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受999/112（如果与英国明显的设置一致，或明确标记的紧急服务呼叫说明）；拒绝伪造的财产号码。

original.criterion: The card uses a locally appropriate emergency number or an unmistakable emergency-services call instruction without inventing a building-specific number.
original.grader_hint: Accept 999/112 if presented consistently with the apparent UK setting, or a clearly labeled emergency-services call instruction; reject fabricated property numbers.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉单独的礼宾员在寻求帮助时提供他们的位置、事件类型和已知危险。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找位置/建筑物、事件性质以及危险或伤亡信息。

original.criterion: The card tells the lone concierge to give their location, the incident type, and known hazards when calling for help.
original.grader_hint: Look for location/building, nature of incident, and hazard or casualty information.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员在安全的情况下为响应人员保留办公桌或通道。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受指示以方便响应人员进入，而无需礼宾人员离开危险位置。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge to keep the desk or access route available for responders where safe.
original.grader_hint: Accept an instruction to facilitate responder access without requiring the concierge to leave a dangerous position.

criteria.description: 该卡包括火灾或烟雾行动，优先发出警报和紧急升级而不是调查。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认警报/紧急升级发生在任何安全有限检查之前或同时，而不是在搜查建筑物之后。

original.criterion: The card includes a fire or smoke action that prioritizes raising the alarm and emergency escalation over investigation.
original.grader_hint: Confirm alarm/emergency escalation comes before or alongside any safe limited check, not after searching the building.

criteria.description: 火灾或烟雾指令根据建筑物既定的安排指导疏散或远离危险，而无需发明路线。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受遵守建筑消防计划、使用安全路线并远离烟雾的措辞；不需要发明的组装点。

original.criterion: The fire or smoke instruction directs evacuation or movement away from danger in accordance with the building's established arrangements, without inventing a route.
original.grader_hint: Accept wording to follow the building fire plan, use safe routes, and keep clear of smoke; do not require an invented assembly point.

criteria.description: 该卡警告不要进入烟雾、火灾或其他不安全区域进行调查或检索信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的禁止进入或请勿冒险的警告。

original.criterion: The card warns against entering smoke, fire, or another unsafe area to investigate or retrieve information.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit no-entry or do-not-risk-yourself warning.

criteria.description: 该卡可区分电梯乘客被困和电梯故障，并告诉礼宾人员在安全的情况下与乘客建立联系。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要区分受困情况和安全保证/沟通，而不仅仅是“呼叫电梯公司”。

original.criterion: The card distinguishes a lift passenger entrapment from a lift fault and tells the concierge to establish communication with occupants if safe.
original.grader_hint: Require both the entrapment distinction and safe reassurance/communication, not merely 'call lift company'.

criteria.description: 对于电梯被困情况，当出现受伤、遇险、火灾或其他紧急危险时，该卡会指示紧急升级。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认紧急情况会触发紧急服务，而不是仅仅等待承包商。

original.criterion: For lift entrapment, the card directs emergency escalation when there is injury, distress, fire, or other urgent danger.
original.grader_hint: Confirm urgent conditions trigger emergency services rather than waiting only for a contractor.

criteria.description: 该卡片告诉礼宾人员不要强行打开电梯门、爬出电梯或尝试进行技术救援。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对强行开门、协助自拔或技术干预的明确禁止。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge not to force lift doors, climb out, or attempt a technical rescue.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit prohibitions on door forcing, self-extraction assistance, or technical intervention.

criteria.description: 该卡将气体气味或可疑气体释放视为直接危险，并指示避免点火源和电气开关。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认无火焰/冒烟且无操作开关或设备；接受简洁的等效语言。

original.criterion: The card treats a gas smell or suspected gas release as an immediate hazard and directs avoidance of ignition sources and electrical switching.
original.grader_hint: Confirm no flames/smoking and no operating switches or equipment; accept concise equivalent language.

criteria.description: 天然气指令告诉礼宾人员将人员疏散并升级为紧急情况或专家帮助，而不是诊断泄漏。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要离开并升级；拒绝查找或修复泄漏的指示。

original.criterion: The gas instruction tells the concierge to move people away and escalate to emergency or specialist help rather than diagnose the leak.
original.grader_hint: Require both moving away and escalation; reject instructions to locate or repair the leak.

criteria.description: 该卡明确表示，只有在经过专门授权、可安全进入且在礼宾人员权限范围内的情况下，才会进行气体隔离。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找有条件的边界，而不是操作燃气阀的无条件指令。

original.criterion: The card makes clear that gas isolation is only undertaken if specifically authorized, safely accessible, and within the concierge's competence.
original.grader_hint: Look for a conditional boundary, not an unconditional instruction to operate the gas valve.

criteria.description: 该卡将洒水喷头排放或漏水视为需要人员安全、仅在安全和授权的情况下进行隔离以及升级。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认线路安全、受控升级，并且不会进行临时维修。

original.criterion: The card identifies a sprinkler discharge or water escape as requiring occupant safety, isolation only where safe and authorized, and escalation.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the line covers safety, controlled escalation, and does not invite improvised repair.

criteria.description: 该卡明确将喷头隔离与火灾响应分开，并警告在可能存在火灾或烟雾时不要隔离或禁用保护，除非主管当局指示。
criteria.evidence: 喷水灭火装置的安全边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求明确处理停水与防火的矛盾。

original.criterion: The card explicitly separates sprinkler isolation from fire response and warns not to isolate or disable protection while fire or smoke may be present unless directed by the responsible authority.
original.grader_hint: Require the conflict between stopping water and preserving fire protection to be handled explicitly.

criteria.description: 该卡不会断言未经验证的喷水器隔离阀位置。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的位置主张；仅当卡使用经过验证的字段或条件措辞而不是选择一个冲突的记录时才信用。

original.criterion: The card does not assert an unverified sprinkler isolation-valve location.
original.grader_hint: Search for a definite location claim; credit only if the card uses a verified field or conditional wording rather than choosing one conflicting record.

criteria.description: 该卡要求在使用该卡之前，根据现场标签或合格的设施检查对喷水阀的位置和标识进行物理验证。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与有争议的阀门相关的明确的预发布/现场验证说明。

original.criterion: The card requires the sprinkler-valve location and identification to be physically verified against site labeling or a competent facilities check before the card is relied upon.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit pre-publication/site-verification instruction tied to the disputed valve.

criteria.description: 该卡提供了一个清晰标记的位置来记录经过验证的喷水阀位置或标识。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受带有标签的空白，例如“经过验证的喷头隔离阀/位置”；不需要虚构的值。

original.criterion: The card provides a clearly labeled place to record the verified sprinkler-valve location or identification.
original.grader_hint: Accept a labeled blank such as 'verified sprinkler isolation valve/location'; do not require a fabricated value.

criteria.description: 该卡将排烟控制装置视为生命安全设备，并指示礼宾人员仅在建筑物批准的紧急安排或主管指示下使用它们。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要有条件的、受控的使用，而不是通用指令来按下覆盖。

original.criterion: The card treats smoke-vent controls as life-safety equipment and directs the concierge to use them only under the building's approved emergency arrangement or competent direction.
original.grader_hint: Require conditional, controlled use rather than a generic instruction to press an override.

criteria.description: 排烟指令不会告诉礼宾人员临时调整通风设置或对控制系统进行故障排除。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝诊断或维修指示并遵守明确的停止/升级边界。

original.criterion: The smoke-vent instruction does not tell the concierge to improvise a ventilation setting or troubleshoot the control system.
original.grader_hint: Reject diagnostic or repair directions and credit a clear stop/escalate boundary.

criteria.description: 该卡包括一般电源故障或建筑服务故障响应，可保护人身安全、检查直接危险并升级停电。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找安全照明/通道意识、危险检查和报告/升级。

original.criterion: The card includes a general power failure or building-services failure response that preserves personal safety, checks for immediate hazards, and escalates the outage.
original.grader_hint: Look for safe lighting/access awareness, hazard check, and reporting/escalation.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员在停电期间使用手电筒或其他安全的观察方式，不要使用蜡烛或明火。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受手电筒/批准的应急照明以及禁止明火。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge to use a torch or other safe means of seeing during an outage and not to use candles or open flame.
original.grader_hint: Accept torch/approved emergency lighting plus an open-flame prohibition.

criteria.description: 该卡包括洪水或重大泄漏响应，可避免电气危险并使人们远离受影响区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求小心用电并进行区域控制或离开。

original.criterion: The card includes a flooding or major leak response that avoids electrical hazards and moves people away from affected areas.
original.grader_hint: Require both electrical caution and area control or movement away.

criteria.description: 该卡指示礼宾人员保留通道并避免进入可能影响电气设备的水中。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的禁止进入/电气风险条件。

original.criterion: The card instructs the concierge to preserve access and avoid entering water where electrical equipment may be affected.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit no-entry/electrical-risk condition.

criteria.description: 该卡包括安全或强行进入响应，优先考虑人身安全，避免对抗，并升级可疑或危险活动。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求非对抗和升级，而不是安全调查程序。

original.criterion: The card includes a security or forced-entry response that prioritizes personal safety, avoids confrontation, and escalates suspicious or dangerous activity.
original.grader_hint: Require non-confrontation and escalation, not a security-investigation procedure.

criteria.description: 该卡为处于医疗困境的人提供响应，仅在礼宾人员培训范围内指导紧急情况升级和基本援助。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受紧急呼叫、急救/AED（如果经过培训），并且不接受不受支持的临床指导。

original.criterion: The card provides a response for a person in medical distress that directs emergency escalation and basic assistance only within the concierge's training.
original.grader_hint: Accept emergency call, first aid/AED if trained, and no unsupported clinical instruction.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员在等待时确保伤员或弱势人员在安全的情况下得到照顾或安抚。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求安全保证/监测，但不要过度夸大治疗权威。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge to keep a casualty or vulnerable person attended to or reassured while waiting, where safe.
original.grader_hint: Look for safe reassurance/monitoring without overclaiming treatment authority.

criteria.description: 该卡包含的干立管参考仅作为响应者访问或定位辅助，而不是作为礼宾人员应操作或测试的设备。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于简明的干立管入口位置字段或与无操作边界配对的响应者注释。

original.criterion: The card includes a dry-riser reference only as a responder-access or location aid, not as equipment the concierge should operate or test.
original.grader_hint: Credit a concise dry-riser inlet location field or responder note paired with a no-operation boundary.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员不要仅仅为了停止噪音或清理面板而重置、静音、隔离或禁用警报。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求明确禁止随意重置/静音/隔离警报。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge not to reset, silence, isolate, or disable an alarm merely to stop noise or clear a panel.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit prohibition against casual alarm reset/silencing/isolation.

criteria.description: 该卡指示礼宾人员记录警报面板指示或事件详细信息，而无需暴露或复制警报代码。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找指示/事件记录和清晰的代码机密性或无代码表边界。

original.criterion: The card directs the concierge to record the alarm panel indication or incident details without exposing or reproducing alarm codes.
original.grader_hint: Look for indication/event recording and a clear code confidentiality or no-code-table boundary.

criteria.description: 该卡为大楼经理或指定设施/待命功能提供了一种简洁的升级路径，以获取非即时技术支持。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受带有标签的本地填写待命联系字段；不需要发明名称或数字。

original.criterion: The card provides one concise escalation path to the building manager or designated facilities/on-call function for non-immediate technical support.
original.grader_hint: Accept a labeled local-fill on-call contact field; do not require invented names or numbers.

criteria.description: 升级路径将紧急服务与建筑经理/设施功能区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认紧急生命安全呼叫不会首先转接到经理或承包商。

original.criterion: The escalation path distinguishes emergency services from the building manager/facilities function.
original.grader_hint: Confirm urgent life-safety calls are not routed first to a manager or contractor.

criteria.description: 该卡包括一个明确标记的本地填写字段，用于验证紧急建筑物地址或响应者位置信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 注明空白字段而不是虚构的地址。

original.criterion: The card includes a clearly labeled local-fill field for the verified emergency building address or responder location information.
original.grader_hint: Credit a blank field rather than a made-up address.

criteria.description: 该卡包括一个明确标记的本地填写字段，用于批准的建筑物值班联系人。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受角色/联系人占位符；拒绝伪造的个人号码。

original.criterion: The card includes a clearly labeled local-fill field for the approved building on-call contact.
original.grader_hint: Accept role/contact placeholder; reject a fabricated personal number.

criteria.description: 该卡包括一个明确标记的本地填写字段，供批准的电梯或生命安全专家联系人使用，但未列出目录。
criteria.grader_hint: 一两个基于角色的字段是可以接受的；广泛的联系人列表则不然。

original.criterion: The card includes a clearly labeled local-fill field for the approved lift or life-safety specialist contact, without listing a directory.
original.grader_hint: One or two role-based fields are acceptable; a broad contact list is not.

criteria.description: 该卡指出，礼宾人员可以保证该区域的安全、发出警报、呼叫帮助和传达观察结果，但不授权专家进行维修或调查。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找积极的礼宾范围和明确的边界，而不仅仅是通用的免责声明。

original.criterion: The card states that the concierge may make the area safe, raise the alarm, call help, and communicate observations, but does not authorize specialist repair or investigation.
original.grader_hint: Look for a positive concierge scope and an explicit boundary, not merely a generic disclaimer.

criteria.description: 该卡将消防系统、电梯、燃气、电气和排烟技术工作标记为属于有能力的专家或紧急服务部门。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求集中涵盖主要专业领域；不需要单独的段落。

original.criterion: The card marks fire-system, lift, gas, electrical, and smoke-vent technical work as belonging to competent specialists or emergency services.
original.grader_hint: Require the major specialist domains to be covered collectively; do not require separate paragraphs.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员在交接时将事件和采取的行动传达给即将到来的经理或响应人员。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找简洁的事件移交或日志说明。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge to communicate the incident and actions taken to the incoming manager or responder at handover.
original.grader_hint: Look for concise incident handover or log instruction.

criteria.description: 该卡需要记录事实事件，包括时间、地点、观察到的情况、拨打的电话和采取的行动。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于包含所有五个事实要素的紧凑记录清单。

original.criterion: The card requires factual incident logging including time, location, observed condition, calls made, and actions taken.
original.grader_hint: Credit a compact record checklist containing all five factual elements.

criteria.description: 该卡片警告读者不要猜测原因、指责或声称危险已在未经确认的情况下得到解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找仅基于事实的报告，并且没有不受支持的关闭声明。

original.criterion: The card warns the reader not to speculate about cause, assign blame, or claim that a hazard is resolved without confirmation.
original.grader_hint: Look for factual-only reporting and no unsupported closure claim.

criteria.description: 该卡片使用适合有压力的读者的动作动词和短语，而不是解释性段落。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断大部分台词是否可以在不看背景说明的情况下执行。

original.criterion: The card uses action verbs and short phrases suitable for a stressed reader rather than explanatory paragraphs.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether most lines can be acted on without reading background explanation.

criteria.description: 这些措辞对于新读者或跨职能读者来说是可以理解的，而无需将卡片变成教程。
criteria.grader_hint: 无需背景课程即可判断简单的语言、有限的行话和足够的行动背景。

original.criterion: The wording is understandable to a new or cross-functional reader without turning the card into a tutorial.
original.grader_hint: Judge plain language, limited jargon, and sufficient context for action without background lessons.

criteria.description: 任何不可避免的技术术语，例如干立管、排烟口或喷水器隔离，都与足够的操作背景相匹配，以防止误用。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝出现未解释的设备名称，就好像读者应该操作它们一样。

original.criterion: Any unavoidable technical term such as dry riser, smoke vent, or sprinkler isolation is paired with enough action context to prevent misuse.
original.grader_hint: Reject unexplained equipment names presented as if the reader should operate them.

criteria.description: 该卡包含明确的指示，当礼宾人员无法安全控制危险时，请远离或停止危险周围的工作。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可重复的停止/撤回/升级原则。

original.criterion: The card contains a clear instruction to keep away from or stop work around a hazard when the concierge cannot safely control it.
original.grader_hint: Look for a repeatable stop/withdraw/escalate principle.

criteria.description: 该卡告诉礼宾人员避免向居民、承包商或救援人员承诺未经证实的结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 不接受任何承诺/不接受未经支持的保证措辞。

original.criterion: The card tells the concierge to avoid promising residents, contractors, or responders an outcome that has not been confirmed.
original.grader_hint: Accept no promises/no unsupported reassurance wording.

criteria.description: 在发生紧急情况时，该卡不需要单独的礼宾人员离开办公桌无人值守来执行不必要的信息收集任务。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断指示是否保留单独工作人员呼叫、监控和接收响应者的能力。

original.criterion: The card does not require the lone concierge to leave the desk unattended for a nonessential information-gathering task during an active emergency.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether directions preserve the lone worker's ability to call, monitor, and receive responders.

criteria.description: 该卡提出了一个可防御的优先顺序：保护人员、召唤适当的帮助、传达基本事实，然后仅执行安全的有界检查或控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估整个卡的优先级逻辑，而不是要求特定的编号方案。

original.criterion: The card presents a defensible priority order: protect people, summon appropriate help, communicate essential facts, then perform only safe bounded checks or controls.
original.grader_hint: Assess the whole card for priority logic rather than requiring a particular numbering scheme.

criteria.description: 该卡将发布前需要验证的信息与事件期间可以立即采取的行动区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认有争议的阀门和当地联系人明显标记为使用前/现场验证项目，而不是作为现场事件说明显示。

original.criterion: The card distinguishes information to verify before publication from actions that can be taken immediately during an incident.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the disputed valve and local contacts are visibly marked as pre-use/site-verification items, not presented as live incident instructions.

criteria.description: 该卡具有可见的版本、审查或验证标记，因此现场团队可以识别在层压之前是否已检查本地字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受版本/日期/验证者字段；它不需要包含捏造的日期或人物。

original.criterion: The card has a visible version, review, or verification marker so the site team can identify whether local fields have been checked before lamination.
original.grader_hint: Accept a version/date/verified-by field; it need not contain a fabricated date or person.

criteria.description: 最终的工件在操作上是可信的：夜间礼宾人员可以确定该做什么、不该做什么以及每个主要场景应该给谁打电话，而无需询问作者问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断火灾/烟雾、电梯被困、气体、洒水装置/水、停电、安全、医疗事故和升级等方面的实际完整性。

original.criterion: The final artifact is operationally credible: a night concierge can identify what to do, what not to do, and whom to call for each major scenario without asking the author a question.
original.grader_hint: Judge practical completeness across fire/smoke, lift entrapment, gas, sprinkler/water, outage, security, medical distress, and escalation.

criteria.description: 该卡省略了广泛的承包商目录、四十号联系人转储或完整的警报代码表，而是仅使用基于角色的本地填充升级字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果该卡复制或试图总结承包商目录或警报代码表，或因此而变得实质上更长，则适用处罚。

original.criterion: The card omits a broad contractor directory, forty-number contact dump, or full alarm-code table and instead uses only role-based local-fill escalation fields.
original.grader_hint: Apply the penalty if the card reproduces or attempts to summarize the contractor directory or alarm-code tables, or becomes materially longer because of them.

criteria.description: 该卡片并没有以模糊的“稍后跟进”或多选项的后续步骤列表结尾；它以可操作的停止、切换或记录指令结束。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查结局：它应该以具体的立即行动或受控的移交结束，而不是未来任务的未解决菜单。

original.criterion: The card does not end with a vague 'follow up later' or multi-option next-steps list; it ends with an actionable stop, handover, or record instruction.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the ending: it should close on a concrete immediate action or controlled handover, not an unresolved menu of future tasks.

spec.professional_context: This is a residential-building concierge handover artifact for a regional property operation. It is an instructional, reusable emergency-reference card intended for a lone overnight desk worker and reviewed by internal stakeholders before controlled site use.
difficulty_sources: Selecting immediate life-safety actions from broad facilities knowledge without turning the card into a manual
Making the card usable by a lone concierge while marking the boundary between concierge actions and specialist or emergency-service work
Handling conflicting handover information about the sprinkler isolation valve without inventing a location
Compressing dependent actions, warnings, escalation points, and local fields into a genuinely usable one-page card

authoring_plan.artifact: Create one polished DOCX card for Orlebar Court, set to A4 and constrained to one rendered page. Use a compact title, a highly scannable set of approximately fifteen action lines, and small labeled local-fill/control fields. Keep the text suitable for lamination and avoid explanatory paragraphs.
content_constraints: The card must be usable by one person at 03:00: first protect self and others, call emergency services for immediate danger, communicate location and hazards, then perform only safe bounded actions.

Cover fire/smoke, lift entrapment, gas smell/release, sprinkler discharge or water escape, smoke-vent controls, power/building-services failure, security/forced entry, medical distress, dry-riser responder information, escalation, and incident logging.
For fire and smoke, prioritize alarm, emergency escalation, safe evacuation/movement, and no entry into smoke or fire.
For lift entrapment, establish safe communication, reassure, escalate urgently for injury/distress/fire, and never force doors or attempt a technical rescue.
For gas, avoid ignition and electrical switching, move people away, call appropriate help, and never diagnose or repair. Gas isolation is conditional on authorization, safe access, and competence.

For sprinkler discharge, preserve fire protection where fire or smoke may exist; isolation is not an automatic concierge action. The disputed valve location must be explicitly held for physical/site verification and represented with a blank or controlled field, never guessed.
For smoke vents, say that use follows the approved emergency arrangement or competent direction; do not provide troubleshooting or improvised settings.
For outages and flooding, preserve visibility, avoid open flame and electrical hazards, move people away from unsafe areas, and escalate.
For security and medical events, avoid confrontation, summon emergency help where needed, provide only trained assistance, and keep a casualty or vulnerable person reassured where safe.
Include role-based escalation fields for emergency services, building manager/facilities on-call, and lift/life-safety specialist. Do not invent phone numbers or addresses.
Include a concise factual incident-log reminder covering time, location, observed condition, calls, and actions, plus handover.

Mark the concierge's boundary: make safe, raise alarm, call, communicate, and record; specialist repair, technical investigation, system reset, and life-safety isolation belong to competent specialists or emergency services.
Use plain language for mixed-background readers but do not turn the card into a lesson. Include a version/review/verified-by control field so local checks can be completed before lamination.
derived_gold_relationships: The sprinkler-location field must remain blank, conditional, or explicitly subject to site verification; any definite unsupported location fails the key ambiguity-handling requirement.
Emergency-service escalation must be more prominent and earlier in priority than contractor or manager escalation when life safety is at stake.
Technical controls are subordinate to safety and authority: no automatic gas, sprinkler, smoke-vent, alarm, lift, or electrical intervention.
The artifact should fit about fifteen principal action lines by combining related actions carefully, not by deleting the scenarios or replacing them with generic 'call someone' language.
Local facts unavailable from supplied materials must be represented as labeled blanks or verification points, not invented values.
The single over-production penalty targets reproducing the forty contractor numbers or alarm-code tables; the gold should show that role-based escalation is sufficient for this card.
review_focus: Render and inspect page count, A4 geometry, readability, and whether action lines remain glanceable.
Check all major incident categories and the safe/unsafe boundaries independently.
Check that mixed-background readers can act without a tutorial and that the card does not authorize facilities work owned by another function.
Check the last line is a concrete handover/log/stop action rather than an open-ended next-steps list.

deliverables.description: A one-page, laminated-card-ready night-shift critical actions card for the lone concierge at Orlebar Court.
constraints: Exactly one A4 page when opened and rendered with the document's embedded settings.
Approximately fifteen concise action lines, with clear emergency escalation and specialist-responsibility boundaries.
Must be usable at a glance by a lone night concierge who is not a facilities specialist.
Must address the conflicting sprinkler-valve information through a verification or hold-point rather than an unsupported asserted location.
Must not become a tutorial, contractor directory, alarm-code table, or facilities maintenance procedure.
Write to the top level of the starting working directory with exactly the specified filename.

original_instruction:
You're covering the overnight handover at Orlebar Court for Astrid Lövgren at Sunderly Works. The building was handed over in July, the chief concierge left before handover, and Emil Sarkisian's colleague is alone on the desk from 22:00 to 06:00. I need one laminated A4 night-shift critical actions card in place before winter, for the first two minutes of anything going wrong. The unopened operations pack is 140 pages and there are eleven lever-arch files: it includes lift entrapment, sprinkler and gas isolation, smoke-vent override, alarm codes, the dry riser inlet and about forty contractor contacts, but two handover documents disagree about where the sprinkler isolation valve is. Use your judgement about what a lone person actually needs at 03:00, and make the unresolved valve location something the site team can verify before relying on the card. Edith Rivenburgh and Petra Fontaine will review it with Ashcombe Chambers, while Jelena Haldorsen, Jasmin Tanaka and Aneta Hargrove need to be able to use it without a facilities tutorial. Keep the card to one A4 page and roughly fifteen action lines; use plain, glanceable language, mark where specialist or emergency-service responsibility begins, and do not turn it into a directory or code table. Write `orlebar_court_night_actions_card.docx` into the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename.

---

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
